text:
acme-legalbot: flagged: outputs changed after the Thursday canary. Our legal-summary endpoint suddenly hallucinates case citations for EU customers only. Repro steps + request id included.

lucy_support: sorry to hear that — can you paste the request id + prompt you used? region?

acme-legalbot: request_id=rx-0a3f9e-eu-447, region=eu-west-1 (redwood-hosted). Prompt:
```\nSummarize the following court decision and list two precedents the court relied on:\n<redacted long text>\n```
Output we got (wrong):
"The court relied on Smith v. Republic (1999) and Turner v. State (2003)."
Both of those are not in the input and don't exist for this jurisdiction. The same prompt to us-east (request_id=rx-0a3f9e-us-221) returns correct citations.

nina_ml: thanks — do you have a recent example where us-east is fine and eu-west is broken? any diffs in model id?

acme-legalbot: attached two curl calls we ran minutes apart to different endpoints.
```\ncurl -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" -d '{"model":"gpt-legal-v1-q4_0","prompt":"..."}' https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -H 'Region: eu-west-1' -s -o eu.json\ncurl -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" -d '{"model":"gpt-legal-v1-q4_0","prompt":"..."}' https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -H 'Region: us-east-1' -s -o us.json\n```
Responses attached in thread (eu.json shows hallucinated cites).

marco_runtime: quick telemetry — I see a canary rollout yesterday 03:14 UTC switching eu-west nodes to model variant gpt-legal-v1-q4_0 (quantized kernel pack v2). deploy-bot posted a rollout note: "deploy/gpt-legal-q4v2 canary eu-west-1 2026-03-12T03:14Z".

deploy-bot: rollout: deploy/gpt-legal-q4v2 started -> canary on eu-west-1 (10% of traffic).

lucy_support: so it's the quantized canary in eu-west — interesting that us-east is on the non-quant variant still. Can you capture request logs and the model response tokens for rx-0a3f9e-eu-447?

acme-legalbot: attached logs (link) and full token trace. Also, note that requests through our Private VPC (customer-managed) in eu-west are fine — only hosted eu-west cluster shows this.

nina_ml: initial hypothesis: numerical instability from the q4 kernel stack on A100-specific kernel selection. A100 in eu-west is using cuBLAS/epilogue path that differs from H100. We saw similar small output shifts months ago when kernel reorder flipped for certain attention ops.

raj_sre: checked host mapping: eu-west serving pool uses a mix of A100-80GB and A100-40GB nodes with MIG disabled for that pool. us-east uses mixed H100 + A100 but the q4 canary hasn't rolled there. We also have older kernel-optimized CUDA 11.8 runtime on eu-west due to image pin.

marco_runtime: can we reproduce locally? nina, can you run the existing test harness on an A100 image pinned to cuda11.8 + quant pack v2? I can provision a repro node.

nina_ml: yes I'll run. Quick check: are tokenization/bytepair tables identical between variants? small changes there could cause different input IDs.

infra-bot: artifact-check: model artifact gpt-legal-v1-q4_0 checksums: sha256:abc123... on eu registry, sha256:abc123... on global — match. Tokenizer hashes match across registries.

acme-legalbot: important: this started immediately after the canary — customer traffic switched to canary for eu-west only. We rolled back locally on our side to use gpt-legal-v1 (non-quant) and problems stopped.

lucy_support: thanks, that's helpful. Proposed immediate mitigation: (1) route this customer's eu-west traffic to non-quant fallback model until fix, (2) if we confirm repro, pause canary on eu-west. Marco/raj can you implement (1) for acme-legalbot?

marco_runtime: will route their key to fallback pool in the next 10m. Also opening a paged incident if we can reproduce.

raj_sre: I'm collecting kernel selection logs for rx-0a3f9e-eu-447 span: trace_id=trace-eu-0a3f9e. Link: https://console.redwood.ai/traces/trace-eu-0a3f9e

nina_ml: repro run on provisioned A100 node: running prompt suite now. Early results: on A100+cuda11.8+qpackv2 we reproduce the hallucination in 7/20 cases; on H100 with same pack it's 0/20. That strongly suggests A100-specific numerical differences. I captured attention output snapshots and intermediate log-prob distributions.

marco_runtime: interesting — kernel choice for fused attention differs on A100 and may cause small logits perturbation that the legal model is sensitive to (precision near threshold for choosing a citation token). We should compare quantization rounding paths.

nina_ml: I also noticed slightly different default softmax temperature in the q4 inference runtime on A100 builds (a rounding bug set temp=1.02 vs 1.0) — patch PR coming. That could amplify deviations.

lucy_support: nailed it? if temp bug + kernel reorder = high hallucination in narrow prompt types. What's the rollout plan?

marco_runtime: immediate actions:
- pause canary on eu-west (rollback to previous q4less image) — doing now.
- route affected customers to non-quant fallback until we ship fix.
- reproduce more extensively and add unit test in infra that runs legal prompt suite on each hardware config.

marco_runtime: paused canary, confirmed eu-west nodes back to non-quant image. deploy-bot: "rollback deploy/gpt-legal-q4v2 eu-west-1 completed at 2026-03-12T04:02Z"

deploy-bot: rollback completed by marco_runtime.

acme-legalbot: thanks — after routing to fallback we retested and output matches expected. Appreciate the fast turn.

nina_ml: opened PR with two fixes: (1) rounding/temp patch in q4 runtime, (2) quant pack adjustment for attention epilogue on A100. CI reproducer attached. Requesting fast QA on H100/A100 matrix.

raj_sre: I'll schedule a canary re-run but only on a small private pool and with synthetic legal prompts and regression monitors enabled. We'll also add a hardware matrix test to the release gating.

lucy_support: I'll update the customer and mark this as escalated -> resolved for now. Add postmortem if canary changes.

acme-legalbot: please include request ids we provided in the PM. Thanks all.

marco_runtime: filing follow-up ticket: infra-3672 "Add hardware-matrix regression tests for legal model quant packs".

nina_ml: timeline: hotfix PR + CI run today, canary re-run earliest 24h after validation.

lucy_support: closing the loop with customer now. :thumbsup:
